name: Zombie Polar Bear
description: The Winterworks polar bear: a powerful, dangerous bear with a massive shoulder hump, a long thick neck, a long heavy head with a strong brow and small dark eyes, straggly fur cards (fur_*, hidden when shorn) and big paws with dark claws. Cream fur with cool blue-grey shadows. Zombie parts (zombie_*) are transparent here and only drawn on the zombie polar bear. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
